title: Linear algebra of graph planes: (Gp), (Nor), norm comparison, rotations, continuity
statement: For n >= 1 and l >= 0 there is L_0 = L_0(n,l) in (0, 1/4] such that, writing P_q(A) for the orthogonal projection of R^(n+l) onto q(graph A) = (span{graphPoint v (A v)}).map q (A : R^n -> R^l linear, q a linear isometry of R^(n+l)), |.| for the Hilbert-Schmidt norm and ||.|| for the operator norm: (1) if |A|, |B| <= L_0 then |A - B|^2 <= |P_q(A) - P_q(B)|^2 <= 3|A - B|^2; (2) if |A| <= L_0 then |A|^2 <= |P_q(A) - p_{rotatedPlane q}|^2; (3) if ||A|| <= 1 then |y - A x| <= 2 |w - P_q(A) w| for w = q(graphPoint x y), all x in R^n, y in R^l; (4) ||A|| <= |A| <= sqrt(n) ||A||; (5) every n-dimensional subspace T equals rotatedPlane q for some linear isometry q; (6) A -> P_q(A) is continuous.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∃ L₀ : ℝ, 0 < L₀ ∧ L₀ ≤ 1 / 4 ∧ (∀ (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (A B : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ), hsNorm A ≤ L₀ → hsNorm B ≤ L₀ → hsNormSq (A - B) ≤ hsNormSq (((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (A v))).map q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap).starProjection - ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (B v))).map q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap).starProjection) ∧ hsNormSq (((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (A v))).map q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap).starProjection - ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (B v))).map q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap).starProjection) ≤ 3 * hsNormSq (A - B)) ∧ (∀ (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ), hsNorm A ≤ L₀ → hsNormSq A ≤ hsNormSq (((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (A v))).map q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap).starProjection - (rotatedPlane q).starProjection)) ∧ (∀ (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) (x : Rn n) (y : Rn ℓ), ‖A‖ ≤ 1 → ‖y - A x‖ ≤ 2 * ‖q (graphPoint x y) - ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (A v))).map q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap).starProjection (q (graphPoint x y))‖) ∧ (∀ A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ‖A‖ ≤ hsNorm A ∧ hsNorm A ≤ Real.sqrt n * ‖A‖) ∧ (∀ T : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), Module.finrank ℝ T = n → ∃ q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ, rotatedPlane q = T) ∧ (∀ q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ, Continuous fun A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ => ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (A v))).map q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap).starProjection)
